easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Ghostly Flicker.
description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
